query: INSERT INTO user_to_sign_up(username, password, first_name, last_name,  recovery_email, recovery_phone_country_code, recovery_phone_number,  otp_hash, otp_expiry, sign_up_attempts) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4,  $5, $6, $7,  $8, $9, 0) ON CONFLICT (username) DO UPDATE SET password = EXCLUDED.password, first_name = EXCLUDED.first_name, last_name = EXCLUDED.last_name, recovery_email = EXCLUDED.recovery_email, recovery_phone_country_code = EXCLUDED.recovery_phone_country_code, recovery_phone_number = EXCLUDED.recovery_phone_number, otp_hash = EXCLUDED.otp_hash, otp_expiry = EXCLUDED.otp_expiry WHERE EXCLUDED.otp_expiry > NOW();
